instructions: Choose one ordinary input from the current screenshot. Keys are held for one second and released. Arrow keys and J/K are deterministic mouse aliases available to both cohorts. In gameplay the mouse turns the view; in menus it moves the cursor. These descriptions explain controls only.

forward_left.description: Hold W and A to move diagonally forward and left.

forward_right.description: Hold W and D to move diagonally forward and right.

sprint.description: Hold W and left Shift to run forward.

jump_climb.description: Hold Space to jump or hold onto a climbable surface.

forward_climb.description: Hold W and Space together to move forward and jump or climb.

interact.description: Hold E to interact; when fully downed, hold the same interaction key to give up.

primary.description: Hold J, the shared left-mouse alias, to climb or use the held item.

secondary.description: Hold K, the shared right-mouse alias, to offer a helping hand or use the alternate item action.

look_left.description: Hold Left, a shared input alias that moves the mouse left at 600 pixels per second.

look_right.description: Hold Right, a shared input alias that moves the mouse right at 600 pixels per second.

look_up.description: Hold Up, a shared input alias that moves the mouse upward at 600 pixels per second.

look_down.description: Hold Down, a shared input alias that moves the mouse downward at 600 pixels per second.

drop.description: Hold Q to drop or throw the selected item.

menu.description: Press Escape to open or close the menu.

slot_4.description: Press 4 to select the backpack slot.

click_target.description: Left-click the visible menu button or interface control you locate.

point_target.description: Move the pointer onto a visible interface element without clicking.

stash.description: Press Tab to stash the selected item in the backpack.

forward_primary.description: Hold W and the left mouse button (J alias) to move forward while climbing or using the held item.

climb_leap.description: Hold left Shift and the left mouse button (J alias) to leap while climbing.
